name: Integra Switchgear Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, Integra Switchgear
Ltd manufactures Electrical Switches and 
other Electrical Products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) ISL is a part of the Bosma Group
b) It is an ISI mark as per IS: 8828-1996 certified manufacturer for Miniature Circuit Breaker [MCBs] and Distribution Boards (DBs). 
c) The group is into Design & Development to Production to Marketing to After Sales Service
d) Company manufactures and supplies Electrical Apparatus for Switches (Including Relays) as per the requirement/specifications of its clients

cons: Stock is trading at 24.6 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -19.8% over last 3 years.
